sentences.text: Jajula Venkatesh, vs The State Of Ap on 16 September, 2019

Author: U. Durga Prasad Rao
Bench: U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Criminal Petition No.5352 Of 2019
Order:

The petitioners/A1 to A4 seek to quash the proceedings against them in Crime No.376 of 2019 of Tadepalli Police Station, Guntur Urban, registered for the offences under Sections 270, 273, 328 and 420 of IPC and Sections 56, 57 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act (for short, 'FSS Act').

2. The allegations against the petitioners briefly are that on 07.07.2019 at 05.00 p.m., when the complainant along with his staff proceeded to Venkatesh Cool Drinks Shop, situated at Pathuru Road, Kunchanapalli Village, Tadepalli Mandal, found the banned tobacco products in their possession and on enquiry, they came to know that the petitioners/A1 and A2 are selling the banned tobacco products by purchasing the same from A3 and A4 and hence, seized the banned tobacco products and registered a case in Crime No.376 of 2019 for the offences stated supra.
3. Learned counsel for petitioner while denying the FIR allegations would submit that even if the prosecution case is accepted to be true, tobacco products would not fall within the definition of Section 3(j) of FSS Act and therefore, the Police are not authorized to register the crime, investigate and file charge sheet and therefore, registration of the FIR is contrary to the provisions of FSS Act.
He relied upon the order of this Court in Crl.P.Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.08.2018.
As can be seen, in the said common order a learned Judge of this Court partly allowed the criminal petitions and quashed the offences punishable under Indian Penal Code and FSS Act.

4. Following the above order and for the reasons recorded therein, this criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings initiated against the petitioner under Sections 270, 273, 328 and 420 of IPC and Sections 56, 57 and 63 of FSS Act are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, in this case shall stand closed.

U. DURGA PRASAD RAO, J 16.09.2019 SS Jajula Venkatesh, vs The State Of Ap on 16 September, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39669562/
